decisions.reason: This yogurt stays close to the firm's core organic dairy range and its early award signal plus likely multi-year survival make withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
The onion-and-pepper cheese was presented as a flagship item and, if still in the assortment by 2022, it is likely strategically important enough to retain.
The semi-hard cheese wheel fits the established cheese business well, but as a more standard and less differentiated extension it faces some risk of later assortment pruning.
The spicy cheese line matches the firm's cheese competence, yet having several variants raises complexity and makes selective rationalization more plausible than for the strongest core items.
The mild creamy soft cheese appears to play a useful portfolio-completing role in the soft-cheese range, though it is still somewhat exposed to cleanup of secondary products.
